result.response:
I have implemented the `encryption` package and integrated it into `config`, `fileutil`, `storage`, and `handler` on the `feature/encryption` branch:

- **Package `encryption`** ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go), [encryption_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption_test.go)):
  - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L251-L258) validates 32-byte keys and wraps [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L39) on invalid key sizes.
  - [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L260-L274) streams AES-256-GCM in up to 64KB chunks with header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), per-chunk 4-byte big-endian length prefix + unique 12-byte nonce + ciphertext + 16-byte GCM tag, 4-byte zero sentinel, and 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 trailer over all chunk bytes between header and sentinel, with idempotent `Close()`.
  - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L387-L407) lazily validates and decrypts the stream in `Read()`, checking header magic, version, chunk authenticity, truncation, and trailer HMAC integrity.
  - [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L45-L53), [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L93-L144), and [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/encryption/encryption.go#L161-L245) support `env`, `file`, `literal`, and `derive` key sources with mutual-exclusivity validation.
- **Job Configuration** ([job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/config/job.go)):
  - Added `Encryption encryption.Config` field and [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/config/job.go#L140-L142) method to [`config.Job`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/config/job.go#L50-L67).
  - Exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/config/job.go#L120-L138) including encryption configuration validation.
- **File Naming** ([filenutil.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/fileutil/filenutil.go), [storage.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/storage/storage.go)):
  - Updated [`EnsureFileSuffix`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/fileutil/filenutil.go#L30-L46) and [`EnsureFileName`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/fileutil/filenutil.go#L48-L51) with `shouldEncrypt bool` to idempotently append `.enc` after `.gz`.
- **Handler Pipeline Integration** ([jobhandler.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/handler/jobhandler.go), [jobhandler_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/handler/jobhandler_test.go)):
  - Added `encryptor *encryption.Encryptor` parameter to [`storageReadWriteCloser`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/handler/jobhandler.go#L32-L67) chaining gzip compression into `EncryptWriter`.
  - Updated [`JobHandler.save`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-hqiarse4/handler/jobhandler.go#L70-L157) to fail fast on encryption key loading/validation errors prior to storage operations.
